name: buyme-acoffee
title: Buy Me Coffee Button
description: A tiled cream card covered in handwritten 'coffee' script with a yellow cup tile at centre; hovering clears the pattern to a yellow card reading 'Buy me a coffee' with a heart and bigger cup.
use: A creator or indie page wants a playful, obvious link for visitors to leave a tip.
avoid: The large patterned card is bold and branded; it dominates a layout and clashes with muted palettes.
a11y: The link's artwork is SVG with no accessible name or alt, so it announces as an unlabeled link; the hover swap ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A square cream card filled edge to edge with black handwritten 'coffee' script in a loose repeating pattern. At its centre sits a white rounded tile holding a yellow square, inside which a black-outlined takeaway coffee cup stands upright.
behaves: Hovering wipes the script pattern away, shrinking it to reveal a yellow card with a small pink heart sticker, a larger coffee cup and hand-lettered 'Buy me a coffee' across the top. Moving away restores the patterned cover.
customise: Three className props let you restyle the card, icon and text layers; the SVG coffee artwork, link URL and palette live in the file and need editing.
weight: light: A large inline SVG and CSS transform transitions; no script loop.
demo: Text repeats 'coffee'; the hover card reads 'Buy me a coffee'.
issues: The link has no text or aria-label, so its purpose is invisible to screen readers.
The hover-only swap means touch users only ever see the patterned cover.
polishWhy: Distinctive hand-drawn art and a fun reveal; hover-only second state and unlabeled link are flaws.
